name: Student Catriona

intro.text: I'm at the Gaelic college, doing Chessmen history. Do you know the queens put their chins in their hands? It's a wonder they didn't all fall over. Let me show you what I've got.

win: You've a fine strategy. Ever thought of playing chess?
after: The Lewis Chessmen were found in 1831, but we only truly learnt how special they were once somebody knew what they were. A great many things sit in drawers.
